text: The internet. So in general, cellular networks are extremely good in providing high quality service to fast users. And then of course there are satellite networks that have a huge footprint, so they are extremely good in providing connectivity also to highly mobility users because even if users move at extremely high speed. The footprint of a satellite is huge, so as the user moves, they can stay connected with the satellite. However, let's focus on Wi-Fi and cellular. Think of a user that moves very fast. Why are we saying that cellular is better than Wi-Fi in providing connectivity to highly mobile users? What do you think? Why is cellular more suitable to provide connectivity to highly mobile users? Remember what we said about coverage. It's related to that also because Wi-Fi coverage is smaller typically than the cell.
